dog.description_text:
Meet Paulie! This handsome little hunk recently joined Every Last One Rescue.

Paulie is a small guy with a whole lot of charm. He's loose, wiggly, and always has that tail wagging. He arrived at the shelter alongside four other dogs and a cat before making his way into foster care. One of those dogs is actually a familiar face around here, our very own Princess Buttercup, who's also in foster care with ELO!

We can't wait to get to know this sweet boy better and share more about Paulie! Check back soon for more updates on this little cutie.
dog.name: Paulie
